_about: Translator context for every key in ui/menu.ui.i18n.json (JSON cannot carry comments). Key format: namespace:region.screen.purpose. A unit test requires one entry per key.
terms:game.title: Game title. EN fixed: White Myth: Nezha.
terms:hero.nezha: Player character name, pinyin. Never translate.
terms:place.dragonPalace: The crystal palace under the East Sea (setting).
terms:weapon.spear: Nezha's spear; 2.4 m, fire at the tip.
terms:weapon.wheels: Flaming wheels under Nezha's feet; he always hovers on them.
terms:weapon.sash: Nezha's red silk sash (混天绫). EN: Red Armillary Sash.
terms:boss.dragonKing: Boss name, title-card form. HUD and subtitle forms differ (see spec section 8).
ui:menu.common.language: Accessible label of the 中文 / EN toggle group.
ui:menu.start.title: Start screen heading; references the game title term.
ui:menu.start.kicker: Small overline above the title: the location.
ui:menu.start.subtitle: One-sentence premise under the title. Max ~2 lines at 1280x600.
ui:menu.start.begin: Primary button that starts play. Keep short (button).
ui:menu.start.milestone: Build tag shown on the start screen during playtests.
ui:menu.pause.title: Pause screen heading.
ui:menu.pause.hint: Explains that clicking the game also resumes.
ui:menu.controls.title: Heading of the controls list.
ui:menu.controls.move: WASD action: hovering movement (Nezha never walks).
ui:menu.controls.sprint: Hold Shift action: fast dash flight.
ui:menu.controls.lock: R action: lock on to / release the target.
ui:menu.controls.soon: Tag on controls that are not playable yet.
ui:menu.controls.keyMouse: Key cap text for the mouse.
ui:menu.controls.keyLmb: Key cap text for left / right mouse buttons.
ui:hud.hint.noTarget: Toast when R finds nothing within 25 m. Budget 28 chars.
ui:hud.hint.targetLost: Toast when the lock breaks beyond 30 m. Budget 28 chars.
ui:hud.hint.locked: Toast when lock-on succeeds. Budget 28 chars.
ui:hud.hint.unlocked: Toast when the player releases the lock. Budget 28 chars.
ui:hud.tip.clickToLook: Top tip while playing without pointer lock.
